e2ee.badgeTooltip: Only participants can read these messages — not AlfyChat, not anyone else.
e2ee.introDm: Messages in this conversation are end-to-end encrypted: nobody else, not even AlfyChat, can read them.
e2ee.introGroup: Messages in this group are end-to-end encrypted for each of its members.
e2ee.vaultNote: Messages you have read stay on this device, encrypted, and are erased when you log out.
e2ee.safetyDesc: Compare these digits with {name}, out loud or in person. If they match on both sides, nobody is sitting in the middle of your conversation.
e2ee.safetyUnavailable: {name} has no encryption key yet: there is nothing to compare for now.
e2ee.keyChanged: {name}'s security key has changed. This happens after logging in on a new device — check with {name} if in doubt.
e2ee.keyMissing: {name} has no encryption key yet: they need to log in once to receive your messages.
e2ee.startedHere: End-to-end encryption enabled — messages above were sent unencrypted

locked.notMember: Sent before you joined — encrypted for the members at the time.
locked.noKey: Your decryption key is missing on this device. Log in again with your password to restore it.
locked.unreadable: This message cannot be decrypted on this device.

plain.tooltip: Sent before end-to-end encryption was enabled.

send.skipped: {n} member(s) without an encryption key won't be able to read this message.

errors.NO_LOCAL_KEY: Your encryption key is missing on this device — log in again.
errors.NO_RECIPIENT: No member can receive this encrypted message.
errors.DM_NOT_ALLOWED: This person doesn't accept your direct messages.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are no longer part of this conversation.
errors.SAVE_FAILED: The message could not be saved.
errors.default: The message could not be sent.

thread.startDm: This is the beginning of your conversation with {name}.
thread.startGroup: Welcome to the beginning of the {name} group.
thread.offline: Offline — showing messages saved on this device.
